question: convoluted internal bore to hit low A finger positions at low D pitch
miter_correction: Coltman 2006: compensated (beveled, d=1.26*ID) 90-deg miter = straight tube shortened 0.32*ID, mode-independent
verdict: Low A finger positions + playable register 2 are mutually exclusive at 22mm cylindrical bore with plain keyless toneholes. Geometric route (stepped levels) inverts hole ordering; acoustic route (graded deep chimneys) places holes within 9mm of low A targets but registers separate by up to 1.5 semitones.
